story.titleZh: 安德森：F1超车难题遍布各赛道，非马德里独有
story.summaryZh: 前F1工程师加里·安德森表示，马德里赛道（马德里赛道）首站基本不存在真正的竞争性超车，而这一问题在当前几乎所有F1赛道上都普遍存在。
story.originalTitle: Gary Anderson: F1's overtaking problem is bigger than one circuit
story.summaryEn: Former F1 engineer Gary Andersen says competitive overtaking was basically absent at the Madring's first race, and argues the problem is common to most, if not all, current F1 circuits.
detailZh: 在一级方程式于马德里环道（马德里赛道）举办的首场比赛中，基本上不存在有竞争性的超车，但事实上，目前的一级方程式赛道中很多——甚至所有——都是如此。
我使用“有竞争性的超车”这个说法，是因为从本赛季开始以来，我们确实看到过一些激动人心的比赛，但这主要是得益于对性能不足的电池组的能量回收与释放管理。
当一辆车的电池已经耗尽，而另一辆车还有电能可以释放时，我不认为这算是有竞争性的超车。这种情况之所以发生，是因为后方工程师团队制定出的能量回收与释放策略在谋略上胜过了另一支车队的策略。
从根本上说，这与车手的技术毫无关系，而正是车手技术，才是我认为包括我在内的数以百万计的观众收看一级方程式的原因。
但先把这个总体问题放一边，说说另一个问题……
我仍然认为这些赛车太依赖下压力了，尤其是前翼。当你在这一区域损失下压力时，就会产生转向不足，基本上你就会损失圈速。
所以如果你因为更快而追上了另一辆赛车，由于下压力损失你会变慢，就无法完成超车动作。而且由于下压力的损失，赛车会开始更多地滑动，进而导致轮胎过热。
当你追到距离前车一分半到两秒以内时，就会出现这个问题。要获得额外的能量部署来帮助超车，你必须处于前车一秒以内。所以我觉得不需要脑外科医生也能知道这套机制行不通。
其次是轮胎。倍耐力通过国际汽联（FIA）来规定外倾角、保温毯温度以及出毯轮胎胎压。这样做是为了降低轮胎失效（公开出丑）的风险，因此这些年来轮胎胎压大幅提高。
大家一直希望降低胎压，但实际上从来没有真正实现过。
在以前使用普利司通（Bridgestone）轮胎的年代，我们在赛道上前轮胎压约为20磅每平方英寸，后轮约为16磅每平方英寸。而目前前后轮胎压都更接近约25磅每平方英寸。
胎压等于抓地力。胎压越高，轮胎越硬，轮胎接触面就越小，导致抓地力下降，从而产生更多打滑。当打滑达到一定程度时，轮胎表面开始过热，抓地力会再次下降，于是你就陷入了恶性循环。
不要娇惯车队。我建议倍耐力应该给出外倾角和胎压的建议，但允许这些非常能干的车队自己决定实际使用什么样的外倾角和胎压。
是的，有些车队会往风险那边推，但车队对赛车的其他部分本来就是这么做的，比如发动机冷却、刹车冷却，甚至机械和空气动力学的调校。
既然说到轮胎，在马德里赛道（马德里赛道），倍耐力带来了C2硬胎、C3中性胎和C4软胎，基本上是其系列中的中间档。赛前大家都在说这条赛道会是一个轮胎杀手。好吧，我有个消息要告诉你和你的模拟数据：并不是。
皮埃尔·加斯利在比赛中用一套硬胎跑了56圈中的55圈；法拉利用中性胎通过了第一节排位赛，兰多·诺里斯和基米·安东内利带着满油箱用中性胎跑了14到15圈，没有任何轮胎衰退的迹象。
大多数车手在排位赛中都能通过用同一套软胎跑出快——慢——快的圈速来提升圈速，而在正赛中，尼克·霍肯伯格和马克斯·维斯塔潘用软胎起步，在赛车载油最重的情况下跑了14圈。更值得一提的是，比赛后段费尔南多·阿隆索用软胎跑了24圈，所以请别再告诉我这套轮胎配方的选择已经到了极限！
我也不同意奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里所说的中性胎在“比赛开始阶段简直糟透了”的说法。他的队友驾驶同样的赛车，用同样的轮胎一路远遁而去。
如果选择软一号的C5、C4和C3配方，将会给各车队带来更大的策略挑战；一些赛车可能会遭受更严重的轮胎衰退，而轮胎抓地力的差异很容易引发超车。
倍耐力不太确定这是否会改变比赛，但至少这会让一切都更接近极限，而不是总是处在安全的一边——后者只会导致在硬胎上跑出漫长的节段（阶段）。
还有一个因素，那就是运气好，在虚拟安全车（VSC）期间正好进站，省了一次便宜的进站（pitstop）。
现在来说说马德里赛道。是的，这条赛道的布局并不利于制造超车，而被大肆宣传的带倾角的“纪念碑”（La Monumental）弯角也只是有点雷声大雨点小。如果赛车在那个赛段还有可用的电能，本来是可以全油门通过的，但大多数车手都稍微收了点油来回收一些能量，因为这样做能让他们在下一段短直道上更快。
那种刹车和过弯特性叠加在一起的弯角从来都不利于超车。基本上，轮胎一次只能干一件事；这就是为什么我们看到这么多锁死（lock-up）的情况——刹车进入弯道时内侧轮胎没有被压上，而这个轮胎随后又会成为受压的轮胎。
所以我有一个关于赛道修改的建议：取消5号弯和5A弯，用一个弯道来替代原来的减速弯（chicane）。
这意味着你将以有机会晚刹车超越其他车手的态势到达7号弯。然后取消11号弯，以提高进入12号弯的速度。如果有一个有挑战性的弯角，那就让它更有挑战性吧！取消16、17、18和19号弯，把它变成一个长弯，就像蒙扎的大弯道（Curva Grande）一样，并在那个区域设置第三段直道模式。
然后，作为我异想天开的建议，像保罗·里卡德赛道50多年前所做的那样，设置一个带中间天桥的两段式维修区。这将使它从F1最长的维修区变成最短的。我确信，如果这成为现实，再配合更软的轮胎选择，将会促成多次进站。
为了减少进站时间上可能出现的差异，车队锦标赛排名前五的车队可以使用其中一段，另外六支车队使用另一段。不过我很确定，凭借如今的模拟工具，两段的差距可以调整得相当均衡，而且投入使用后，只需移动维修区限速控制线就可以进一步优化。
detailEn: Competitive overtaking in Formula 1’s first race at the Madring basically didn’t exist, but that is true of many, if not all, of the current F1 circuits.

I use that phrase ‘competitive overtaking’, because, since the beginning of this season, we have seen some exciting racing, but that has been mainly down to harvesting and deployment of an inadequate battery pack.

I don’t call it competitive overtaking when one car has run out of battery while another car still has some electrical energy to deploy. This happens because the backroom engineers have come up with a harvesting and deployment strategy that simply outwits another team's harvesting and deployment strategy.
Basically, it is far removed from any driver skill, and driver skill is the reason I believe behind why many millions of other viewers and I watch F1.
But moving on from that general problem to another…
I still believe the cars are too downforce-reliant, especially the front wing. When you lose downforce in this area, it creates understeer and basically you lose laptime.

So if you have caught another car because you are faster, because of that downforce loss you are slower, and you can’t pull off an overtaking manoeuvre. Also because of that loss of downforce, the car starts sliding around more and then overheats the tyres.

If you get to within one and a half to two seconds of the car ahead, you then have this problem. To get any extra deployment to help with overtaking, you need to be within one second of the car in front. So I don’t think you need to be a brain surgeon to know this doesn’t work.

Secondly are the tyres. Pirelli instigates, through the FIA, the camber, blanket temperatures and out-of-the-blanket tyre pressures. This is done to reduce the risk of a tyre failure (public embarrassment), so the tyre pressures have increased dramatically over the years.
There has been a desire to lower them, but it's never actually happened.
Back in the old days, when we had Bridgestone tyres, we would use on-track pressures of ~20psi at the front and ~16psi on the rear. Currently, they are running front and rear at more like ~25psi.

Tyre pressures equal grip. The higher the pressure, the stiffer the tyre and the smaller the tyre contact patch becomes, resulting in less grip, which creates more sliding. At a certain level of sliding, the tyre surface starts to overheat and you get less grip again, so you get into a spiral.

Don’t mollycoddle the teams. I would suggest that Pirelli should advise camber and tyre pressures, but allow these very competent teams to decide for themselves what camber and tyre pressures they actually run.
Yes, some teams will push into the risk side, but that is what a team does with the rest of the car, i.e. engine cooling, brake cooling and even the mechanical and aerodynamic set-up.

Whilst on about tyres, for the Madring, Pirelli brought the C2 hard, C3 medium and C4 soft tyres, basically the middle of its range. All the talk prior to the event was that this circuit was going to be a tyre-killer. Well, I got news for you and your simulations: it wasn’t.

Pierre Gasly did 55 of the 56 laps in the race on one set of hards; Ferrari got through first qualifying on the mediums, Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli did 14-15 laps on the mediums on full tanks with no sign of tyre degradation.

Most drivers were able to improve their laptime in qualifying by doing fast - slow - fast laps on the same set of softs, and in the race Nico Hulkenberg and Max Verstappen started on softs and did 14 laps when the car was at its heaviest. To cap it off, later in the race Fernando Alonso did 24 laps on the softs, so please don’t tell me the tyre compound choice was on the limit!
And I don’t agree with Oscar Piastri that the medium tyre was “just awful at the start of the race". His team-mate in the same car was steaming off into the distance on the same tyre.

One step softer to the C5, C4 and C3 would have meant a greater strategy challenge for the teams; potentially some cars would have suffered more tyre degradation, which can very easily lead to overtaking because of the difference in tyre grip.

Pirelli's not so sure it would have changed the race, but at the very least it would have put everything more on the limit as opposed to always being on the safe side, which simply leads to these long stints on the hard tyre.
Then there is the bit about the luck of getting a cheap pitstop during a VSC interlude.

And now we get onto the Madring circuit. Yes, it wasn't the best track layout to instigate overtaking and the much hyped banked ‘La Monumental’ corner was just a bit of a damp squib. It would have been flat out if the cars had had the electrical energy available at that point of the lap, but most had a little lift to harvest some energy, knowing that they were better off by doing that for the next short straight.

Corners that have compound braking and cornering characteristics never promote overtaking. Basically, the tyres can only do one thing at a time; that is why we see so many lock-ups when the inside tyre is unloaded whilst braking for a corner where that tyre will be the loaded tyre.
So here is my suggestion for circuit changes: do away with Turn 5 and 5A and make it one curve instead of a chicane.

This means you will arrive at Turn 7 with the potential to outbrake another driver. Then do away with Turn 11 to increase the entry speed into Turn 12. If you have a challenging corner, then let’s make it challenging! Do away with Turns 16, 17, 18 and 19 and make it one long curve, which is like Curva Grande at Monza and have a third straight mode in that area.

And then, for my way out wacky suggestion, do what Paul Ricard did over 50 years ago and have a two-part pitlane with a bridge in the middle. This would mean it would go from the longest pitlane in F1 to the shortest. I am sure if that happened, combined with a softer tyre selection, it would instigate multiple pitstops.

To mitigate any potential differences in pitstop time the top five teams in the constructors’ championship could use one section and the other six teams could use the other section. Although I’m pretty sure with today’s simulation tools both sections could be equalised fairly well, and when in place it could be optimised by just moving the pitlane speed limit control lines.
keyPointsZh: 安德森认为本赛季部分精彩比赛主要源于电能回收与部署策略的差异，而非车手技术
他指出当一辆车耗尽电量而另一辆仍有电能可部署时，由此产生的超车不能称为竞争性超车
他强调车手技术才是包括他在内的数百万观众观看F1的原因
keyPointsEn: Andersen believes this season's exciting racing has mainly come from battery harvesting and deployment strategies rather than driver skill
He argues overtaking caused by one car running out of battery while another still has electrical energy cannot be called competitive overtaking
He stresses driver skill is the reason he and millions of other viewers watch F1

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
